section.subsection: As used in this section:"County officer" means a county assessor, a member of a county board of equalization, or any other individual who holds a county office."Multicounty assessing and collecting levy" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-2-1601.
The commission shall take corrective action if the commission determines that a county officer has materially failed to perform a duty under this chapter relating to the assessment of property.

Corrective action under Subsection (2) may include one or more of the following actions:notifying a county officer in writing of the performance issue;ordering factoring pursuant to Section 59-2-704;subject to Subsection (4):recommending the removal of a county officer; orfiling a petition for a court order requiring a county officer to take action;reporting suspected misconduct or malfeasance of a county officer to law enforcement agencies, as appropriate; andtaking any other action the commission determines is appropriate to ensure that:all assessments of property are uniform and equal, according to fair market value; andthe tax burden is distributed without favor or discrimination.

subsection.subsection: Before taking a corrective action described in Subsection (3)(c) against a county officer, the commission shall publish notice of the commission's intent to take the corrective action on:the commission's public website; andthe Utah Public Notice Website created in Section 63A-16-601.

After taking a corrective action described in Subsection (3)(c) against a county officer, the commission shall provide written notice of the corrective action to:the county officer subject to the corrective action;the county legislative body of the county for which the county officer described in Subsection (4)(b)(i) holds office;the state auditor;the president of the Senate; andthe speaker of the House of Representatives.

section.subsection: If the commission determines that a county officer has materially failed to perform a duty under this chapter relating to the assessment of property for a period of one year or longer, the commission shall:assist the county officer in performing the duty required by this chapter; andcharge the county the full amount of the commission's costs in providing assistance under this Subsection (5).
